summary: Independently reviewed both original AISEC-009 and retained MCP-02 clauses. Authorization and token ingress require exactly one explicit supported resource before grants are mutated; literal configured issuer identification is emitted on validated authorize responses, and access tokens are issued and verified for the configured MCP audience and issuer. The HTTP handler checks configured/supplied resource-profile agreement. Required source and relevant negative-test definitions are unchanged from the prior integrated cc62682 review.
limitations: Bounded local resource/issuer/audience contract only. Existing source/native/hosted evidence is retained at its original revisions; this review launches no app, database, provider or client. It does not implement granular grant migration, per-effect native-session revocation, full connection journeys, public-client certification, deployment, installation or release acceptance. Native prerequisite #206 and exact final-main CI remain required.

criteria.criterion: AISEC-009: Check the requested resource, audience and issuer consistently during authorization, exchange and token verification.
criteria.basis: Independent current-source review plus unchanged retained qualification. Final acceptance revision CI is checked separately by the completion gate.

criteria.criterion: MCP-02: Retain this original scope/history in the detailed canonical issue: | MCP-02    | Bind JWT audience to the MCP endpoint        | Implemented; other audiences rejected                                                            |
criteria.basis: Independent current-source review plus unchanged retained qualification. Final acceptance revision CI is checked separately by the completion gate.

findings: Repeated, missing, empty and unsupported resource values fail at ingress/schema boundaries before exchange or refresh mutation.
The authorization HTTP redirect uses the literal configured issuer; JWT verification restricts algorithm, issuer and audience and verifies persisted token state and subject binding.
MCP-02 is retained as its own original acceptance clause, rather than dropped as redundant with AISEC-009. Wrong audiences are denied by the verification contract and regression definitions.

retained_evidence.status: Historical supporting evidence only; no CI result claimed for the eventual new acceptance revision.

provenance_limit: GitHub authenticates the later delegated posting principal only. This actual Codex review task and retained report are process provenance, not an independently authenticated GitHub reviewer.
